t_advice_summary_textbox.text: blue, yellow, orange, green takes to one forest, red, purple, brown to another. The number of mushrooms in each forest decreases as you collect from it, and simultaneously increases in the other forest. Therefore you should switch between the forests as the number of mushrooms decreases to maximise yield.

vb_textbox.text: The green, yellow, blue and orange gnomes take you to one forest, the pink, purple and brown gnomes take you to another. Select one forest consistently until you see the number of mushrooms consistently decreasing (they may go up and down). Then switch to the other forest and repeat until the mushrooms start to decrease again. Don't forget to press the space bar to collect the mushrooms!
